title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: PLAC — Rom 5 'all sinned in Adam' = became wicked/God's enemies (habitual sense)
pass_a_gloss: Calvin's follow-on gloss for Rom 5: 'all sinned in Adam' means they were wicked and enemies of God. Placeus insists that quasi-habitual sense of the verb and noun 'sin' be carefully kept in view.
pass_b_english: And a little later: so Rom. 5, in Adam all sinned—that is, they were wicked and enemies of God. Which quasi-habitual sense of the verb and noun "sin" is to be carefully observed.
source_text: Et paulo post: sic Rom. v. in Adamo omnes peccaverunt: id est, scelerati ac Dei hostes fuerunt. Quae quasi habitualis significatio verbi & nominis peccati diligenter observanda est.
notes: Cap. IX immed/Clavis densify section 627 from locked 1661 Latin (pp. 351–352 tip).
